description: This file defines the Schedule class within the OrangeHRM framework, specifically for managing scheduled tasks in the console environment. It includes methods for adding, retrieving, and setting tasks, as well as generating unique task identifiers.

classes.name: Schedule
classes.description: A class for scheduling, managing, and executing tasks in the OrangeHRM console framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Schedule with dependencies on Console and OutputInterface.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new task based on CommandInfo, with validation to prevent specific commands.

methods.name: getTasks
methods.description: Returns the list of all scheduled tasks.

methods.name: setTasks
methods.description: Replaces the current task list with a new set of tasks.

methods.name: getDueTasks
methods.description: Filters and returns tasks that are due based on the provided timezone.

methods.name: generateUniqueId
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier for a task, ensuring no collisions with existing task IDs.
